description: Searches Neblla's store of paid things; never buys. Each result has its price in euro cents, `held`, a `load` line and, when not held, a `buy` link to give the developer: a thing loads in an app only if the app's owner holds its licence. Free pieces: neblla_assets. More: neblla_get_llms tools/store_search

action.description: "licences" lists what the developer already holds. By action: search {query?, kind?, limit?}; get {id}

query.description: search: what you look for, in any words.

name: neblla_store_search
title: Search the Neblla store
